d: For years, Dubai has attracted global wealth, businesses and entrepreneurs. But it has also served as a refuge for wanted criminals accused of drug trafficking and money laundering. That is now changing as the United Arab Emirates strengthens its cooperation with foreign law enforcement agencies, leading to high-profile arrests and extraditions. In this video, Firstpost examines three reasons behind the UAE’s tougher approach: expanding extradition agreements, efforts to trace and seize illicit wealth, and the need to protect its reputation as a global financial hub.
